title: reqlan base config
description: Optional per-base Reqlan configuration (.reqlan/config.json). For an .rq document, the applying file is the owning base's .reqlan/config.json (nearest ancestor directory that owns a .reqlan folder).

importRoots.description: Import-root alias mappings. Each entry binds an alias string to a directory. When omitted or empty after validation, the default mapping is alias '@' with the workspace folder as root. When several aliases could match a path, the longest alias wins.

alias.description: Prefix used before '/' in aliased import paths. Example: alias '@' matches '@/reqs/style.rq'.

root.description: Directory this alias resolves against. Relative paths are resolved from the base root (the parent of .reqlan). Absolute filesystem paths and file:// URIs are also accepted. When omitted, the workspace folder that contains the .rq file is used.

click.description: Optional click-session defaults for CLI and MCP click. Controls how many click sessions are kept per base under .reqlan/click-sessions.sqlite.

maxSessions.description: Maximum click sessions retained per base. Eviction drops the least recently touched sessions first. Default 100.

export.description: Optional export defaults used by Reqlan export commands. These values provide defaults for prompt-driven exports and can be overridden per run.

outputFolder.description: Default output directory for exported files. Relative paths resolve from the base root (the parent of .reqlan).

printEntryFileName.description: Filename for the printable HTML entry page used by HTML and PDF export flows.

includeRequirementsPage.description: Whether to emit the requirements listing page.

includeGraphPage.description: Whether to emit the graph page.

clusterStrategy.description: Default cluster generation strategy for HTML export.

includeIdeaPages.description: Whether to emit dedicated page-per-idea detail pages.

includeFilePages.description: Whether to emit dedicated pages for reqlan files that host ideas. Defaults to true.

includeCodeFilePages.description: Whether to emit dedicated pages for outbound file_reference (code) targets. Defaults to true.

includeClusterPages.description: Whether to emit cluster detail pages.

includeAttributePages.description: Whether to emit dedicated pages for each attribute key. Defaults to true.

includePrintPages.description: Whether to emit static printable pages in addition to the interactive site.
